name: What is the difference between group classes and personal training?
description: Group classes offer general workouts in a shared setting; personal training provides one-on-one, customized instruction and immediate feedback.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between group classes and personal training?

acceptedAnswer.text: Group classes offer a shared experience with a general workout program for multiple participants, while personal training provides one-on-one instruction tailored exclusively to your needs. The main practical tradeoff is personalized attention versus a communal atmosphere. Personal training allows for highly customized programming, immediate form correction, and focused goal achievement, whereas group classes can be motivating and cost-effective but less individualized.
